events.description: A consulting-driven event where participants develop product solutions, tackle real-world business crises, and showcase their strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
rules: 3 Rounds:
Round 1 – Product Problem Solving
Round 2 – Business Case Study
Round 3 – Consulting Interview

events.description: A case-study driven event where participants analyze real-world scenarios and demonstrate their analytical thinking, problem-solving approach, and decision-making abilities.
rules: 3 Rounds:
Round 1 – Aptitude Assessment
Round 2 – Case Study Analysis & Submission
Round 3 – Final presentation

events.description: A placement-focused event designed to equip biotechnology students for internships and full-time opportunities. The competition evaluates participants across core biotechnology knowledge, consultancy thinking, and software/application skills — helping them sharpen industry-ready problem-solving and communication abilities.
rules: Solo participation only
Round 1 – Computer-Based Test (Aptitude + Core Biotech Assessment)
Round 2 – Group Discussion followed by Personal Interview
Participation is mandatory for all biotechnology students

events.description: An engaging event that blends current affairs with interactive game-based challenges — designed to make learning more exciting, competitive, and fun.
rules: Participation allowed in Solo or Duo format
Open to all branches and academic years
2 Rounds: Round 1 – Quiz based on current affairs, Round 2 – Fast-paced Buzzer Round

events.description: An engaging core biotechnology event that blends technical knowledge with fun and creativity. Participants will progress through interactive rounds featuring biotech concepts, visual challenges, puzzles, anagrams, and themed question sets designed to test both understanding and quick thinking.
rules: Team size: 3 members (minimum one participant from the Biotechnology department)
Event consists of 3 rounds:
Round 1 – Written test covering PCM fundamentals and core biotechnology
Round 2 – Live interactive round including images, puzzles, anagrams, and more
Round 3 – High-pressure buzzer finale to determine the winning team

events.description: Build innovative tech solutions using AI, software development, and data analytics to solve real-world problems.
rules: At least one Biotechnology student must be part of the team.
